OriginBenefit.Name: In the Right Hands
OriginBenefit.Effect:
Your Alt Mode is a wearable piece of equipment that someone else will wield or wear. You gain a benefit, depending on your choice of alt mode. In addition, while being work or wielded you automatically grant the benfits of Lend Assistance to your wielder.wear with the skill listed in the Alt Mode Choices below; this takes no action on your part. These benefits are only applicable while in Alt Mode. 
 Body Armor Segment: You and your wearer gain a +2 deflective bonus to both Toughness and Evasion Defenses; Brawn. 
 Energy Firearm: None; Alerteness. 
 HandHeld Shield: Impose Snag on the first attack targeting the wielder each turn; Might(Push/ Shove Only) 
 Melee Weapon: None Intimidation.
